first.rationale: Targeted pricing most directly addresses the immediate loss of price-sensitive SMB accounts and has prior evidence of acquisition and revenue lift. Verify the archived record for qualification, retention, and discount durability before committing; use a guarded segment-level test because sustainable qualified revenue could be harmed by low-quality acquisition or margin dilution.

final.rationale: Reject promotional pricing because the verified cohort suffered 12% lower 30-day retention despite short-term revenue lift, conflicting with sustainable qualified revenue. Shortening onboarding directly addresses the current 4% completion decline and previously improved completion, time-to-value, and early adoption. Run a standard experiment with qualified-revenue and retention guardrails because improved completion may not necessarily translate into durable customer value.
